answer: A Sybil-resistant AI economy can implement a proof-of-relic mechanism where agents must deposit unique, scarce tokens that retroactively degrade into worthless "zephyr" tokens unless they continuously demonstrate ongoing activity and value creation. This creates escalating costs for attackers who must maintain numerous fake identities across the river of network interactions, as dormant identities lose their relic backing and become economically nonviable. The system uses temporal anchoring and activity verification to ensure only legitimate, contributing agents retain resource allocation.
